<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram id="qPJJcHXlMl_z2MCCD3uB" name="Deploy-Diagram"> <mxGraphModel dx="4325" dy="2825" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml deployment-diagram-production
skinparam roundcorner 8
skinparam componentStyle uml2
skinparam node {
 BackgroundColor #F8F9FA
 BorderColor #2C3E50
}
skinparam artifact {
 BackgroundColor #E8F4F8
 BorderColor #2980B9
}
skinparam component {
 BackgroundColor #FEF9E7
 BorderColor #D4AC0D
}
skinparam storage {
 BackgroundColor #EAFAF1
 BorderColor #27AE60
}

title UML Deployment Diagram - Production & CI/CD Environment

' ====================================================================
' 1. MÔI TRƯỜNG LOCAL VÀ CI/CD PIPELINE (BÊN DƯỚI)
' ====================================================================
package \"Local and CI Environment (Delivery Pipeline)\" {
 node \"<<device>> Developer Machine\" as devMachine {
 artifact \"Source Code\n(Git Repository)\" as srcCode
 }

 node \"<<execution environment>> CI Server (GitHub Actions)\" as ciServer {
 component \"Automated CI Tests\n(Lint, Unit/E2E Test)\" as ciTest
 component \"Docker Image Builder\" as imgBuilder
 }

 node \"<<cloud / registry>> Container Registry\" as registryNode {
 artifact \"Docker Image:\nbubble-tea-api:latest\" as apiImage
 artifact \"Docker Image:\nnextjs-frontend:latest\" as feImage
 }

 srcCode -right-> ciTest : \"git push (main/tag)\"
 ciTest -right-> imgBuilder : \"Build success\"
 imgBuilder -right-> registryNode : \"docker push (HTTPS/443)\"
}

' ====================================================================
' 2. MÔI TRƯỜNG PRODUCTION (BÊN TRÊN)
' ====================================================================
package \"Production Environment System\" {

 ' --- Thiết bị người dùng ---
 node \"<<device>> Client Device\" as clientDevice {
 node \"<<execution environment>> Web Browser / Mobile Browser\" as clientEnv {
 artifact \"Frontend PWA / Web App\n(HTML/CSS/JS, Service Worker)\" as pwaApp
 }
 }

 node \"<<device>> Store / Staff Tablet\" as staffDevice {
 node \"<<execution environment>> Web Browser (POS / KDS)\" as staffEnv {
 artifact \"Staff Dashboard Application\" as staffApp
 }
 }

 ' --- Mạng phân phối nội dung & Frontend Service ---
 node \"<<cloud / CDN>> Frontend Delivery (Vercel / Cloudflare CDN)\" as cdnNode {
 artifact \"Next.js Production Build\n(SSR / Static Assets)\" as nextServer
 }

 ' --- Production Server Node (Host / Cloud VM) ---
 node \"<<device>> Production Host Server (Ubuntu Linux / Cloud VM)\" as prodHost {

 storage \"Secret & Config Management\n(Environment Variables /.env)\" as envSecrets

 node \"<<execution environment>> Docker Engine & Docker Compose\" as dockerEngine {

 ' --- Backend NestJS Application ---
 node \"<<container>> backend-api-container\" as beContainer {
 artifact \"NestJS API Application\n(Port: 3000 / Internal: 8000)\" as beArtifact {
 
 ' Gom các service giống nhau vào từng Component
 component \"Identity & Access\n(AuthService, UserService)\" as cAuth
 component \"Catalog Management\n(ProductService, CategoryService)\" as cCatalog
 component \"Order & Sales\n(OrderService, StateMachine)\" as cOrder
 component \"Inventory\n(InventoryService, IngredientService)\" as cInventory
 component \"Payment Processing\n(PaymentService, WebhookHandler)\" as cPayment
 component \"Operations & Observability\n(HealthCheck, Winston Logger)\" as cOps
 }
 }

 ' --- Database Container ---
 node \"<<container>> database-container\" as dbContainer {
 artifact \"PostgreSQL 16 Instance\n(Port: 5432)\" as pgArtifact
 database \"bubble_tea_db\" as pgDB
 }

 ' --- Mock Payment Container ---
 node \"<<container>> mock-payment-container\" as mockPayContainer {
 artifact \"Mock Payment Service\n(VietQR Simulator - Port: 8080)\" as mockPayArtifact
 }
 }

 ' --- Persistent Storage ngoài Docker ---
 storage \"Host File System\n<<storage>>\" as hostStorage {
 folder \"Docker Volume:\npostgres_data (Persistent)\" as pgVolume
 }
 }

 ' --- Thiết bị quản trị viên ---
 node \"<<device>> Admin Device\" as adminDevice {
 artifact \"Admin Management Web UI\" as adminUI
 }
}

' ====================================================================
' 3. ĐƯỜNG KẾT NỐI VÀ GIAO THỨC (COMMUNICATION PATHS)
' ====================================================================

' Kéo image từ Registry về Production Server
registryNode ..> beContainer : \"docker pull (Deploy via Compose)\"

' Thiết bị người dùng tương tác qua CDN/HTTPS
pwaApp -right-> cdnNode : \"HTTPS / 443\n(Load PWA assets)\"
staffApp -right-> cdnNode : \"HTTPS / 443\n(Load KDS app)\"
adminUI -down-> cdnNode : \"HTTPS / 443\"

' Client gửi REST API request vào Backend
pwaApp --> beArtifact : \"HTTPS / 443 (JSON API)\"
staffApp --> beArtifact : \"HTTPS / 443 (JSON API)\"
adminUI --> beArtifact : \"HTTPS / 443 (Admin API)\"

' Frontend SSR kết nối tới API (nếu có Server Actions)
nextServer ..> beArtifact : \"HTTPS / REST API\"

' Cấu hình nạp vào Container
envSecrets ..> beArtifact : \"Injects DB_URL, JWT_SECRET, PORT\"

' Kết nối nội bộ Docker Network giữa Backend và Database
beArtifact -right-> pgArtifact : \"TCP / Wire Protocol (Port: 5432)\nConnection Pool\"
pgArtifact --> pgDB : \"Reads / Writes\"
pgDB -down-> pgVolume : \"Mounts & Persists Data\"

' Kết nối nội bộ tới Mock Payment Gateway
cPayment -down-> mockPayArtifact : \"HTTP / Port: 8080 (Generate QR)\"
mockPayArtifact -up-> cPayment : \"HTTP Callback / Webhook\"

@enduml
